This article is about the 23w13a_or_b grid of blocks.   For the current grid of blocks, see Debug mode/Grid.   For the upcoming grid, see Debug mode/Grid/upcoming.



This article is a work in progress. 
Please help expand and improve it. The talk page may contain suggestions.Note: Section new blocks states





This article documents an April Fools' Day joke. 
This feature was exclusively part of a joke version and is not currently planned for addition to regular Minecraft.

This page lists all the rows in the debug mode block grid in 23w13a_or_b.
There are 156 lines with up to 157 block states. The last line has 86 block states. Therefore, there are 24.421 block states in total.
The first block is located at coordinates (1, 70, 1) and each block is 2 blocks away from its adjacent blocks, thus the block in row r, column c is at coordinates (2r-1, 70, 2c-1).
